dict: Holds label metadata; grain = one row per label_name (label identifier); notable columns = label_name (key), label_display_name.
images: Holds image-level metadata; grain = one row per image (image_id); notable columns = image_id (key), subset, original_url, original_landing_url, license, author_profile_url, author, title, original_size, original_md5, thumbnail_300k_url.
annotations_bbox: Holds bounding-box object annotations; grain = one row per annotated bounding box on an image; notable columns = image_id (fk), source, label_name, confidence, x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, is_occluded, is_truncated, is_group_of, is_depiction, is_inside.
labels: Holds image-level labels/tags; grain = one row per (image_id, label_name, source) label assignment; notable columns = image_id (fk), source, label_name, confidence.
